jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer at AppleOne Employment Services
jobs.description: Employer: AppleOne Employment Services Expires: 09/20/2026 About ActOne GroupActOne Group Industries builds and deploys AI agents and automations that run real business workflows for enterprise clients. Our platform, Foundry, lets teams design, build, and ship AI applications and agents — and we work side-by-side with clients to get those solutions into production. We're a small, fast-moving team where the work you do reaches customers quickly. About the RoleThis is a Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) internship — but you don't need a traditional engineering background. You need sharp business instincts, genuine curiosity about AI, and the drive to learn how to build.Forward Deployment Engineers sit at the intersection of client and product. You'll learn how to translate a client's business problems into working AI agents and applications, build them on Foundry using Claude Code, and help clients do the same. A big part of the summer is helping us design and build a client training program — alongside our AI Lead — that teaches customers how to build their own AI applications and agents from scratch.If you've been the person who picks up new tools fast, builds things on the side, and likes being in the room with customers, this is for you. Why This Is an Exciting OpportunityThe way work gets done is being rewritten right now, and Forward Deployment Engineers are the people doing the rewriting. You won't be watching the AI shift from the sidelines — you'll be on the front line of it, sitting with real businesses and turning "what if AI could do this?" into something that's actually running in production.This is a rare chance to get genuinely fluent in the tools and workflows that will define the next decade of work, while you're still early. You'll build real AI agents and applications, shape how clients learn to build their own, and develop a skill set very few people have yet: knowing how to take AI from a demo to deployed value. The people who learn this now — how to think with these tools, sell with them, and ship with them — are the ones who will be leading teams and companies in a few years. We're betting that's you. What You'll DoWork directly with clients to understand their workflows, goals, and where AI can create real valueLearn to build AI agents and applications on the Foundry platform using Claude CodeHelp design and build our client-facing training program alongside the AI Lead — the curriculum that teaches clients how to build and deploy their own AI solutionsSupport client onboarding and the hands-on deployment of solutionsGet deep, practical exposure to the leading AI tools — Claude, OpenAI, and the broader stack — and develop strong judgment about when and how to use eachDocument patterns, write clear guides, and turn what works into repeatable playbooks Who You AreStrong business fundamentals — you understand how companies actually operate and make decisionsHands-on AI exposure — you've used tools like Claude and OpenAI extensively, ideally building real things with them, not just experimentingA fast, self-directed learner — comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out without a manualA clear communicator — you can hold your own in a client conversation and explain technical ideas in plain termsPrior startup or technology experience (required) — you've worked at a startup or tech company, founded something, or built and shipped your own product. You know what it's like to move fast in an environment without a playbook.Currently enrolled in a college or university program Bonus PointsA portfolio of AI projects you've built — apps, agents, automations, prompts, anythingFamiliarity with no-code/low-code tools or prompt engineeringExperience in a client-facing, sales, or consulting setting The DetailsLocation: Los Angeles, CA — hybrid (mix of in-person and remote)Duration: SemesterCompensation: Discussed during the interview processGrowth: Strong interns will be considered for a full-time offer after the summer

jobs.title: Hardware & Automation Test Intern / Junior Engineer at Global ETS
jobs.description: Employer: Global ETS Expires: 09/23/2026 About the RoleWe're an innovative semiconductor testing company looking for a motivated student or junior engineer to help us bridge the gap between hardware reality and modern AI-driven automation. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our senior engineers, get hands-on exposure to real test-floor operations in an advanced electronics environment, and contribute to the tools and test flows we rely on every single day.This is a learning-first position. More than a perfect resume, we value your curiosity, your attention to detail, and your willingness to get hands-on with both code and hardware.What You'll Work On1. Circuit Theory & Hardware AnalysisThis is the foundation for everything else. You'll use oscilloscopes and multimeters to trace signal integrity issues and perform power analysis, and you'll carry out basic PCB modifications and SMD soldering under the guidance of senior engineers. Our belief: only when you truly understand what the hardware is doing can AI actually help.2. Process Automation via Vibe CodingYou'll use Python to automate parsing test data, cleaning logs, and generating yield reports—but the point isn't hand-crafting every line. It's about driving development through intent, iterating quickly alongside AI, and being able to read, modify, and verify the code the AI produces. The core of coding is shifting from "can you write it" to "can you steer the AI to write it correctly."3. AI Agentic Test FlowsYou'll help the team evaluate and integrate AI development tools so machine learning can accelerate our debugging and test processes, and you'll assist in developing and maintaining ATE (automated test equipment) test programs. Our goal isn't just to have AI answer questions—it's to design agentic pipelines that can autonomously connect to the bench, run tests, and produce reports.What We're Looking ForEnrolled in (or recently graduated from) an Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related program; a solid foundation in Circuit Theory—you should be able to read basic schematics and understand logic gates; comfortable with at least one programming language (Python or C/C++ preferred) as a basis for collaborating with AI; detail-oriented and willing to dig into unfamiliar hardware systems or massive data logs; and genuinely curious about how software directly controls and tests physical hardware in the real world.Nice to HaveHands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters) or basic soldering skills; coursework or project experience with FPGA development (Verilog/VHDL) or digital logic; familiarity with—or strong interest in—integrating AI/ML APIs for data or coding automation.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative at Inner Peak
jobs.description: Employer: Inner Peak Expires: 09/27/2026 This position is ideal for a recent college graduate looking for their first sales role or a college student looking to earn a little extra money and gain valuable experience. We are a lean team trying to keep costs low. This role is compensated solely based on results - you will be paid per meeting you book for our CEO, as well as a percentage of any deal that closes. There is no base salary, and we have no flexibility on this. If you are not comfortable working on commission only, please do not apply. Summary: Inner Peak AI (www.innerpeak.ai) is blending new AI technology with human therapist expertise to deliver truly personalized, affordable mental wellness support 24/7. We are starting by serving high school and college students but eventually intend to be everyone’s mental wellness safety net, triaging users and delivering them to video content, human therapists, or crisis resources. We are a mission-driven company created out of our founders; own lived experience and struggles with mental health, and are still a small (but motivated) team. Peak’s founders met in undergrad at Harvard a decade ago before reconnecting recently over their shared interest in technology and mental health. We have built and launched a mobile application that has two thousand users and is live at several high schools. Initial student usage data is strong, giving us powerful case studies. To raise our next round of fundraising, we must scale this to more schools. We are looking for hungry interns who care about making a difference in peer mental health and who want high-upside potential through our performance-based compensation. This role is great training for anyone interested in going into sales, as you will report to a sales manager with 10+ years of sales experience. If you are successful at this role, over time it could turn into a full account executive role with a base salary. Responsibilities:You will be acting as a lead-generation sales representative for Inner Peak, talking to real potential customersYou will be calling private and charter school principals, deans of students, directors of counseling, and counselorsYou will learn to use Hubspot, the top startup CRMYour primary goal is to generate interest in Inner Peak’s solution so school leaders will want to see a demo of Inner PeakYour success will be measured in number of meetings booked for our CEO Qualifications:Preference for past sales experience - at minimum you must WANT to sellNo requirement for past sales experience (though it could help), but you have to WANT to sellYou must be personable, friendly, and not intimidated by cold callingInterest in / passion for mental health and / or K-12 educationHard-working, with the ability to put your head down and do callsA self-starter looking to bet on yourself You must be able to devote at least 10 hours a week during normal business hours to the role (though preference for candidates who can devote more)

jobs.feedName: Andrew J. Anagnost College of Engineering and Computer Science
jobs.title: Business Analyst Intern at Right Click
jobs.description: Employer: Right Click Expires: 09/27/2026 Consulting is finally reaching small and medium businesses.Strategy consulting has long had a price floor. A partner sold the work, and a pyramid of analysts did the research, the document review, the benchmarking, the models, the first drafts. That pyramid is roughly why serious advisory work tended to start around $100,000, which left the small and mid-sized businesses that make up most of the economy largely outside the market.That's starting to change. Analytical work that would have taken weeks can now often be done by a agile team with a good AI workflow. It starts to look possible to deliver real advisory work to a 60-person manufacturer in Orange County at a price they'd actually pay.We're a managed IT and cybersecurity firm working with clients across aerospace, defense, healthcare, and professional services in Southern California. We already have the relationships, and we have an unusual amount of data — years of ticket history, systems inventory, security posture, and software spend for every client we serve. It's close to the raw material an outside consultant would spend weeks trying to assemble. We're building a consulting practice that turns that operational data into recommendations clients can act on.What you'd actually doYou'd take a live client, pull their operational data, and look for the story in it — where money is leaking, which systems have quietly become shelfware, what's generating the same ticket forty times a month, where they might be exposed on compliance. Then you'd build the analysis and write up the recommendation.The intent is that your work, with your name on it, shapes what we end up advising a client to do, rather than arriving as a research task with the interesting part already decided.What you leave withA portfolio of real client work, which not many interns get. Real fluency in AI-assisted analysis — a competence a lot of firms are hiring for and most programs haven't caught up to yet. And some sense of what it looks like to build a business model from the inside, which is a different education than a semester of cases about someone else's.We're looking forA business, finance, economics, or analytics student who's curious about how companies actually run, reasonably comfortable with messy data and Excel, and a clear writer. It helps if you've already been using Claude or similar AI tools on your own coursework and have some feel for where they're genuinely useful and where they aren't. More than any of that, we're looking for someone who wants to go find the answer rather than wait to be handed the question.ApplySend a résumé and a short note — three or four sentences on a business problem you've found interesting lately — to [careers@rclick.com].Right Click is an equal opportunity employer.Benefits:401(k)401(k) matchingDental insuranceEmployee assistance programFlexible spending accountHealth insurancePaid time offProfessional development assistanceRetirement planVision insuranceWork Location: In person

jobs.title: Risk Advisory Intern - Summer 2027 - Los Angeles at Grant Thornton
jobs.description: Employer: Grant Thornton Expires: 09/27/2026 Please apply to the position/location you are most interested in. In order to be considered for this position you must: 1. Apply through the Grant Thornton Job portal at www.grantthornton.com/campuscareers (including resume and transcript) Who is Grant Thornton? At Grant Thornton, we believe in making business more personal and building trust into every result – for our clients and you. Here, we go beyond your expectations of a career in professional services by offering a career path with more: more opportunity, more flexibility, and more support. It’s what makes us different, and we think being different makes us better. In the U.S., Grant Thornton delivers professional services through two specialized entities: Grant Thornton LLP, a licensed, certified public accounting (CPA) firm that provides audit and assurance services ― and Grant Thornton Advisors LLC (not a licensed CPA firm), which exclusively provides non-attest offerings, including tax and advisory services. In 2025, Grant Thornton formed a multinational, multidisciplinary platform with Grant Thornton Ireland. The platform offers a premier Trans-Atlantic advisory and tax practice, as well as independent American and Irish audit practices. With $2.7 billion in revenues and more than 50 offices spanning the U.S., Ireland and other territories, the platform delivers a singular client experience that includes enhanced solutions and capabilities, backed by powerful technologies and a roster of 12,000 quality-driven professionals enjoying exceptional career-growth opportunities and a distinctive cross-border culture. Grant Thornton is part of the Grant Thornton International Limited network, which provides access to its member firms in more than 150 global markets. About Advisory Services Grant Thornton’s Advisory professionals are progressive thinkers who create, protect, and transform value today, so our clients have the opportunity to thrive and grow. Our advisory practice creates holistic solutions delivered by innovative, curious professionals who bring technical depth and industry insight to our clients. What is Risk Advisory? Within our Cyber & Risk Solution Family, Risk Advisory helps organizations grow with confidence by delivering agile, technology-enabled risk services that strengthen resilience, improve business performance, and unlock new opportunities. We work with complex organizations to assess, transform, and operate internal controls, risk management, compliance and Internal Audit activities, programs, and functions. POSITION SUMMARY: Risk Advisory Interns are responsible for working on client engagements, including: Assessing business and information technology processes and system internal controls. Executing enterprise, operational, information technology and third-party risk management and compliance programs. Executing internal audit plans, including information technology internal audits. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Understand, document, and assess various client operations, processes, systems, controls, and programs, and identify opportunities for improvement Assist with conducting risk assessments to inform enterprise risk, operational risk and third-party risk management projects, programs and internal audit plans. Assess transactions, processes, systems, and controls to support assessments, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and other regulatory compliance, and internal audit projects. Obtain and analyze data, identify trends, and visualize results using commercially available analytics solutions. Leverage analytics, automation, artificial intelligence (AI), and other technology aids to advance your understanding, drive throughput on project objectives, and deliver client services efficiently and effectively. Establish and maintain good working relationships with team members and clients, and work effectively with client personnel at all levels. Collaborate closely with team members and clients to understand project approach, identify and manage project risks, execute assigned project responsibilities, and recommend opportunities to improve processes, internal controls, risk management, and compliance. Obtain an understanding of relevant industry trends, business objectives, operations, processes, systems, etc. applicable to assigned client projects Assist with business development activities including conducting research, contributing to proposals, and other activities as appropriate. Participate in Firm activities such as recruiting, training, officewide activities, and more. Other duties as assigned. Why become a Risk Advisory Intern? A Risk Advisory Intern will gain exposure to various industries, business processes, operations, systems and controls as an integral member of project delivery teams. As a Risk Advisory Intern, you will be executing high quality Risk Advisory projects and services under the supervision of experienced Risk Advisory team members. You will be responsible for efficiently managing your workload to budget and timeline. What are we looking for in an Intern? We are seeking self-starters and analytical thinkers who are curious, enjoy working in a collaborative, performance-driven environment, and want to help our clients solve complex problems using the latest technology and data-enabled methods. Risk Advisory Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, MIS or related field. Desire to pursue CPA, PMP, CISA, CIA, CISSP, CAMS, CISM, or other relevant license/certification preferred. Overall GPA of 3.0/4.0. Available to travel at least 25% as required. Ability to work additional hours as needed. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. No visa sponsorship is available for this position. Skill Requirements Ability to learn, understand and work across various industries and functional areas within an organization. Excellent analytical, communication (written and verbal), presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong technical aptitude, complex analysis, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Effective project and time management skills. Ability to work in a rapidly growing, fast-paced, interactive, performance-driven team environment. Enthusiasm to learn through a combination of structured, on-the-job and self-directed training. Ability to work efficiently and effectively independently and in a team environment. Desire to pursue applicable professional license/certification as outlined above. TRAINING: Grant Thornton LLP provides both local and national training programs related to an individual’s job responsibilities. We are committed to ongoing professional development, and we encourage individuals to attend outside training seminars. A strong sense of ownership over one’s own training and development is key to success in this role. The team you’re about to join is ready to help you thrive. Here’s how: Whether it’s your work location, weekly schedule or flex time off, we empower you with the options to work in the way that best serves your clients and your life. Consistent with the firm’s hybrid work model, this position will require in-person attendance at least three days per week, either at a GT office or client site. Here, you are supported to prioritize your overall well-being through work-life integration options that work best for you and those in your household. We understand that your needs, responsibilities and experiences are different — and we think that’s a good thing. That’s why we support you with personalized and comprehensive benefits that recognize and empower all the identities, roles and aspirations that make you, well, you. See how at www.gt.com/careers. When it comes to inclusion, we are committed to doing more than checking boxes. Explore all the ways we’re taking action for diversity, equity & inclusion at www.gt.com/careers. Here’s what you can expect next: If you apply and are selected to interview, a Grant Thornton team member will reach out to you to schedule a time to connect. We encourage you to also check out other roles that may be a good fit for you or get to know us a little bit better at www.gt.com/careers. Benefits: We understand that your needs, responsibilities and experiences are different, and we think that’s a good thing. That’s why we support you with personalized and comprehensive benefits that recognize and empower all the identities, roles and aspirations that make you, well, you. For an overview of our benefit offerings, please visit: https://www.grantthornton.com/careers/rewards-and-benefits. Interns also receive a minimum of 72 hours of paid sick leave, and are paid for firm holidays that fall within their internship period. Benefits for seasonal employee positions: Grant Thornton seasonal employees are eligible to participate in the firm’s medical, dental and vision insurance programs and the firm’s employee assistance program. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment, including the application process. To make an accommodation request, please contact HR@us.gt.com. For Los Angeles Applicants only: We will consider for employment all qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. The pay rate for this position in the firm’s Los Angeles, CA office is $40 per hour.

jobs.description: Employer: Coursicle Expires: 09/28/2026 Over 2 million college students use Coursicle to stay on top of their classes and homework.Coursicle is your all-in-one academic planner:Sync and color-code assignments from Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace (D2L), Moodle, and moreGet reminders for upcoming classes, assignments, quizzes, projects, and examsGet notified when classes have open seatsRead reviews of their professorsBuild schedules and create backup schedules for registrationFor the first time since our founding, Coursicle is expanding beyond course registration. jobs.title: RF Design Engineering Intern (10668) at Qorvo
jobs.description: Employer: Qorvo Expires: 09/30/2026 Qorvo’s Internship Program is designed for college students currently enrolled in an accredited Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD program. Qorvo offers real work experience, exposure to upper management, and the opportunity to pursue full-time opportunities, as available. Qorvo’s Internship Program offers:Challenging, skill-building assignmentsMentoring and coaching from industry expertsLaunch & Learns and other learning opportunitiesCollaborative team-based work environmentNetworking and social eventsFinal presentation to business leaders Qorvo’s RF Design Engineering Internships are offered in our High Performance Analog business group. Specific projects and responsibilities will be determined based on the business needs at the time of the internship assignment. Team Overview:The Antenna Technologies team, part of the Defense Missions Technology group within Qorvo's Defense & Aerospace (D&A) business unit, develops advanced phased array antenna solutions that enable our customers to accomplish critical missions. As an intern with our team, you will collaborate with world-class antenna designers, RF engineers, and test professionals that create state-of-the-art products for Satellite Communications, Line-of-Sight Communications, Radar, and other defense and aerospace applications. Responsibilities may include:Complete intern project based on alignment between candidate capabilities and antenna team requirements. Example projects may include:Development of demonstration system that highlights existing antenna team designs that can be used at Qorvo public events and trade shows.Perform testing on existing designs that allow the antenna team to understand performance variations over production.Implement new calibration routines and validate with measured data.Validate new test setups for over the air testing of existing antennas.Support ongoing antenna team design work by performing one or more of the following tasks:Collaborate with mmWave antenna, electrical, RF component, and printed circuit board design engineers to develop mmWave phased array designs for emerging markets and applications.Design passive circuit components, including power splitters/combiners, microstrip and stripline transmission lines, and impedance transformers, using AWR, CST, or HFSS.Support hands-on testing and troubleshooting of RF and mmWave phased array antenna prototypes, including power supplies, control circuits, and RF/mmWave circuits. Qualifications:Currently enrolled in an Engineering degree program, pursuing a Master’s degree (MSEE or equivalent) or higherMinimum GPA 3.0 or higherPrior RF circuit design and/or antenna design experience using AWR, CST, and/or HFSS.Experience designing and/or testing RF and mmWave circuits, coupons, and systems.Preferred Qualifications:Experience with scripting or programming in a language such as Python.Experience designing or testing phased array antennas, beamforming networks, antenna modules, or RF front-end assemblies.Experience working with PCB fabrication and assembly vendors to support prototype builds, design reviews, and failure analysis.Hands-on experience using RF/mmWave test equipment such as VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and probe stations.Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to summarize trade studies, test results, and design decisions for cross-functional teams. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship by the Company. Competitive hourly pay commensurate with experience: $31/hr - $42/hr (subject to change dependent on physical location) Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. Qorvo reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as external competitiveness and internal comparability. Base compensation is one element of Total Rewards offered at Qorvo. More information on the Total Rewards package can be shared upon request.
